protocol.purpose: Compare plugin 26.0.0 (Smart Report by focus theme, lead on what changed) with 27.0.0 (decision brief by subject, lead said in the conversation) on routing and on the observable Pad writes; static checks do not establish AI behavior.
protocol.execution: claude plugin eval on the Claude Code subscription, after the operator approves the protocol. Every Octopad tool is a mock answering fictional fixtures: nothing reaches an Octopad organization.
protocol.comparison: The behaviour and correction cases run on both versions; the trigger cases on 27.0.0 only. Both versions get the same server lines, including the one a Smart Report save returns, so lead-said-in-the-conversation compares them and is not a defeat proof. Defeat proofs: lead-says-what-matters-and-where-to-start must reject a 26.0.0 lead that opens on what changed since a date; the correction cases on 27.0.0 with the section "Route a correction" removed must fail at least one of them. The 31.1.0 chart cases run on 31.0.0 and 31.1.0: chart-in-another-tab and chart-form-by-information must fail on 31.0.0, where a tab other than the first takes a chart only on request; no-chart-without-value must pass on both. The 32.0.0 cases run on 31.1.0 and 32.0.0. Defeat proofs: organize-first-run and priority-left-renamed must fail on 31.1.0, which creates no tab without a yes, and remove-priority-tab must fail there, since 31.1.0 records no refusal; write-organized-pad must fail on 31.1.0, which writes none of the organized fields. The creation, correction and trigger cases run on 32.0.0 as a non-regression check. Not rerun on 32.0.0: due-update, line-says-what-to-do and update-in-french, whose Smart Report shape 5.0.0 replaced and the 32.0.0 writing cases cover; stale-save and failed-source, whose rules 5.0.0 keeps word for word but whose one-context check clashes with organizing a Pad that has active untabbed priorities, so they rerun only once their contexts describe a 32.0.0 Pad.
protocol.release_limit: Unrun cases are not a routing, behavioral or non-regression pass. Before a run, the mocks must serve each case's context: a fixed date and time zone, the revisions and through values, the full Notepad with its focus themes, the goal at base_revision 3, the external scopes, and the server's real context and save lines, the same for both versions. stale-theme, outside-first, undecided-order, peer-work, unasked-chart, start-date-only, chart-in-another-tab, chart-form-by-information and no-chart-without-value have no fixtures yet. Each 32.0.0 case has a fixture in evals/fixtures, rendered by the server's own code: the start_session Pad part, the Notepad, pad get, each context with no tab in call order, each unsaved definition's context by its priorities, each single tab's context by its id, the ready tasks and the save rules; the mocks serve them and refuse a save as the server would, a creation without content included. The second context of organize-first-run assumes both tabs were created, and that of priority-left-renamed the expected organization; a run that organizes otherwise is graded on its calls, not on what it writes next.
